bounded_question: Can a real-shell deep Character task stay visually quiet while persistence is healthy, surface an explicit non-fictional infrastructure exception when needed, and restore the exact prior task/origin/focus after externally resolved recovery without inventing storage/recovery commands or fictional Character behavior?
frozen_inputs: Light F2 / Dark D3 / MAT F1 / TYP F1 / STA F2 / FICON F1
accepted persistence/recovery functional and Phase-3 evidence
source witness: Deep Character inspection · Julian · persistent material
construction_law: Healthy persistence creates no permanent status chip, footer, banner or success color merely to prove persistence exists.
Persistence in progress, read-only, recovery-needed, persistence failure and integrity concern are application/infrastructure states outside fiction.
Persistence failure != corruption/integrity concern; read-only != Character refusal; recovery != fictional rewind, another Take, branch, rehearsal or consequence reversal.
The exception surface must retain and name the exact prior task: Deep Character inspection · Julian · persistent material.
Closing an explanation is navigation only and must not imply recovery, durability, repair, discard or Production mutation.
No user-facing save/retry/repair/recover command is invented. A deterministic test hook may simulate external infrastructure state transitions solely to prove presentation and return behavior.
When the test hook marks recovery resolved, the exception witness disappears, healthy persistence returns to silence, and focus returns to the retained prior-task target.
Accent/color may not encode healthy, saved, recovery success, warning, corruption, severity or safety.
mechanical_acceptance: zero page/internal horizontal overflow in healthy, exception-open, explanation-closed-unresolved and recovered states
zero missing button accessible names and zero undersized icon-only controls
healthy state has zero visible persistence-status witnesses
exception state names retained task/origin and exposes explicit infrastructure status in both themes
Close explanation restores prior-task focus but leaves unresolved status visibly unresolved
externally simulated recovered state removes all persistence status and restores exact prior-task focus
zero fictional Character/Stage/causal-history meaning created by infrastructure states
zero external resources or image dependency
visual_falsification: Healthy persistence fails if ordinary creative work gains ambient saved/status chrome.
Darkness may not imply greater severity, corruption, danger or fiction; Light may not imply safety or successful durability.
Exception presentation fails if application status reads as Julian silence/refusal/incapacity, Stage action or Production causal history.
Persistence failure and integrity concern must not collapse into one meaning.
Closing the explanation must visibly remain unresolved rather than looking repaired or recovered.
Narrow sequencing must preserve prior task, infrastructure explanation and exact focus return.
explicit_non_goals: recovery algorithm, read-only policy or integrity validation
Stage successor, production tokens or native WinUI/XAML implementation
result_law: Only responsive containment and test-state plumbing may be repaired after exposure. Any change to persistence/recovery semantics, fiction boundary or frozen visual roles requires a separately named successor.
